title: Moscow
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Biohazard art. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Moscow Infection card. Black-and-white Europe map, city name down the left edge, white center panel, green ring. No coordinates and no special rule. P4-14b.

rules: Black Infection card for Moscow. One copy. The map is black and white, matching the black city.
The white center panel is the infection-card improvement slot. The green ring is standard infection-card art.
No extra effect is printed. Drawing it infects Moscow by the usual infection rules.
notes: Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
